children: to $0.01 per share of common stock to preserve capital and enhance financial flexibility, the company said on Tuesday.
The dividend dropped from $0.05 per share in the prior quarter. As of Sept. 14, 2026, the company had ~$32.4M in unrestricted cash.

The mortgage REIT also said it resolved a $52.4M loan secured by a Stockbridge, Georgia, multifamily property that had been risk rated “5” and was on nonaccrual status. The company expects to realize a write-off of ~$19.9M, which had been reserved for through a previously recorded allowance for credit losses.
realized two full loan repayments of about -$19.5M secured by office properties located in Ohio and California and has funded ~$7.1M in unpaid principal balance on existing loans.

In July, the company refinanced the assets of two legacy collateralized loan obligations — GPMT 2021-FL3 and GPMT 2021-FL4 — by extending and upsizing the JPMorgan financing facility. As of June 30, the two CLOs had a total outstanding balance of $521M with a weighted average cost of 38 basis points to S+2.00%. The JPMorgan financing facility has a total outstanding balance of ~$651M, a weighted average cost of S+2.17%, and a two-year term with three one-year term extension options.

title: Granite Point Mortgage cuts dividend, resolves $52.4M loan on multifamily property
